## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-*juan* monumental Qīng-period subcommentary on Dìguān's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* ([KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168), T1931) and its principal commentaries, compiled by **Xìngquán** 性權 over four years in the Qiánlóng era and finalised in Kāngxī 44 (1705) per his own preface. The work draws together the entire Sòng-Yuán-Míng *Sìjiào yí* commentarial tradition into a unified comprehensive synthesis. The textual transmission involves three editorial layers: Xìngquán's original Qīng compilation; Jiāqìng-era supplementation-and-correction by the lay-disciple [錢伊庵](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%8C%A2%E4%BC%8A%E5%BA%B5) Qián Yī'ān (錢伊菴居士); and Guāngxù-era systematic arrangement-and-printing by [諦閑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%AB%A6%E9%96%91) Dìxián fǎshī.

**Abstract**

The *Fǔhóng jì* is the most ambitious Qīng-period production on the Tiāntái doctrinal-classification tradition: it integrates the entire Sòng-Yuán-Míng commentarial corpus on the *Sìjiào yí* into a single ten-*juan* synthesis suitable for systematic Qīng-period Tiāntái scholastic study. The work's institutional standing — through its three-stage editorial production extending from the early Qīng (Kāngxī) through the Jiāqìng and Guāngxù periods — demonstrates the continuing institutional vitality of Tiāntái scholarship through the entire Qīng era.
